verdicts.reason: A keeps the dark header with a legible Q logo and the full stack in order: headline, divider, body, CTA, note and legal. It is very cramped, though. The 4-line headline and body crowd each other, the legal text sits nearly at the bottom edge, and the legal text is almost as large as the body copy. B shrinks the logo to an unreadable dot in a thin header strip. Its orange divider runs straight through the body line ('our seaside'), which is a clear collision, and the headline has almost no gap above the body text.
